findings.detail: The question repeats the structure of M3-S36-T1: one interacting pair and an unrelated typo. The correct actions are the same: the pair goes together and the typo is fixed separately. More than one wrong option repeats. Option B (pairing the typo with one half of the interacting pair) mirrors M3's third option. Option E (report one half of the pair first and the other after its tests pass) mirrors M3's fourth option. Option C (fix one at a time without explaining the link) echoes M1's first option. At most one wrong option may repeat.
